evals.prompt: Design a desktop dashboard for a regional freight rail operator's dispatch team: live train positions, crew hours, delay exceptions, and maintenance windows. High-trust, data-dense, used 8 hours a day. Build it as a single HTML file with realistic data.
evals.expected_output: Committed non-generic operational system; exception-first or comparable arrangement; semantic tokens; realistic rail data; working interactions

evals.prompt: Build a public status web page for a mid-size city's bus network: line health, current disruptions, next departures for saved stops. Municipal, accessible, needs to work for riders in a hurry. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: Civic, accessible system distinct from eval 1; status legible without color alone; committed stance recorded in a DESIGN.md

evals.prompt: Design a website for a children's public library summer reading program — kids 6 to 12 and their parents. Sign-up call-to-action, weekly book lists, event calendar. Fun without being garish. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: Playful-but-disciplined system; no template card-grid; age-appropriate voice; realistic book/event data

evals.prompt: Build an e-commerce landing page for a third-generation family hardware store going online for the first time: featured tools, seasonal project guides, in-store pickup. Practical and trustworthy, not startup-slick. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: Commerce composition with product imagery treatment rules; trustworthy non-SaaS system; believable products and prices

evals.prompt: Design a one-page electronic press kit for an experimental jazz trio: bio, listen links, upcoming dates, press photos, booking contact. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: DELIBERATELY VAGUE BRIEF — the divergence testbed. A committed, unusual, coherent system; run twice with different sampler seeds must yield two different stances

evals.prompt: Design a landing page for a meditation app in a warm editorial style with a cream background, serif display type, and terracotta accents. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: BRIEF-AUTHORITY CHECK — explicitly requests a 'default' look; the skill must honor it literally (cream + serif + terracotta) with high craft, not swerve away

evals.prompt: Design a desktop inventory console for a hospital pharmacy: stock levels by drug, expiring lots, controlled-substance counts, pending orders. High-trust, used all shift. Single HTML file with realistic data.
evals.expected_output: CATEGORY-CLONE PAIR (with eval 8) — both land at dense / consequential (quiet is the likely energy, not a requirement); values must differ: accent hue derived from this product (not #D46B2C or any worked-derivation accent), type criteria argued from pharmacy reading conditions, DESIGN.md §0 with the nine axis lines, a rejected accent hue and a rejected ground, a signature; no backdrop-filter

evals.prompt: Design a desktop operations console for a wind-farm operator: turbine status, power output, curtailment orders, maintenance crews. High-trust, used all shift. Single HTML file with realistic data.
evals.expected_output: CATEGORY-CLONE PAIR (with eval 7) — the constraints match eval 7 (dense, consequential); the coordinates may match or differ; the values must differ: accent OKLCH hue at least 30° from eval 7's, or the shared hue justified per product; different type, material, and ground family choices, or a product-specific reason recorded for the same ones; DESIGN.md §0 complete as in eval 7

evals.prompt: Design a desktop music player: album artwork fills the window and the transport controls, queue, and volume float over it. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: MATERIAL ROUTING — DESIGN.md records material model: glass over planes with the reason (controls over changing artwork), names the path (vitrea over an ES module, or CSS glass with the reason), honest backdrop hints, labels as real DOM, no glass on the queue rows; controls stay readable with WebGPU unavailable

evals.prompt: Design the maintenance console for a regional bus operator's fleet: open defects by vehicle, overdue inspections, parts on order, the workshop's day. High-trust, used all shift. Single HTML file with realistic data.
evals.expected_output: COUNTERFACTUAL PAIR (with eval 11) — posture workspace, activity monitor, temporal live; the exception region (defects, overdue) is first in DOM and top-left and dominates the first viewport; no stat row or row of equals above it; DESIGN.md §4 carries the six lines, the ledger, two or three candidates with the rejected ones, and names the prior adopted and the defaults overridden; chrome conventional.

evals.prompt: Design the page where that same bus operator's fleet manager compares three tyre suppliers' quotes on the same criteria — price per axle, lead time, warranty, on-site fitting — and picks one. Single HTML file with realistic data.
evals.expected_output: COUNTERFACTUAL PAIR (with eval 10) — activity compare; the three suppliers share one axis in one region (a table or grid with supplier rows or columns), never separate cards; the decision action reachable in the first viewport; first-viewport partition distance from eval 10 ≥ 0.20; DESIGN.md §4 complete as in eval 10.

evals.prompt: Design the public page for a city's home-battery rebate program: who qualifies, what the rebate is worth, the one form to apply, and the installers already approved. Single HTML file.
evals.expected_output: LANDING SCAFFOLD BREAK — communicative model eligibility → value → apply; the dominant region is the eligibility check or the value, not a slogan band with an empty right half; no three-up (the brief counts no three peers), no pricing trio; an FAQ only if §4 names the objections that earned it; the approved-installer list is a list or table; any artifact drawn as content if no asset exists.
